Location: Ton Son Nhut
Right is Kahn, he was the company clerk, morning report written by him
Tototz is to the left of Kahn
I slept in the hooch, once you enter the door, immediately on the right
researchNotes: Repeats his 2026-08-13 identifications (giscus-vn-0003-c18006986.json) in the same positions, and Kahn's part in the morning reports from 2026-08-23 (giscus-stories-c18118728.json). Which hooch 'the hooch' is, is not said.
